unresolved_on_purpose: Vesper Kane sold the unit. That stays lore_unit_betrayal.hidden_truth. Mama has not told Jax. No quest says the name.
The drone corridor was Mama's logistics, and Vesper used it without tariff. That stays lore_drone_swarm_aftermath.hidden_truth. The eleven dead are not a gunfight.
The Voss letters are a cross-world contingency. They stay lore_voss_envoy.hidden_truth. No cousin is stood on the estate.
Jax's survivor list, the Luminary operative inside it, and Cipher's search for that operative stay their secrets. Neither man has a pin in this slice.
Cipher learned ASL before the injury. Unrendered.
Tomás has been talking to a federal agent for six weeks, and he does not know he is the second-choice heir. He is not stood beside Mama. The role line that names the second choice is not dialogue.
Renny walked one letter toward Fantasy off the books. That is a cross-world secret. He is not stood on the dock, and this slice does not open the Link.
The lieutenant on the federal conversation is Marquez's godson. The public tension says lieutenant. The quest says lieutenant. The kinship stays the secret.

Iris is the anonymous source, and Navarro has already identified her and is letting the case build. Both facts are secrets. The public tensions still say the source is unknown and that some other accountant keeps a private ledger. The two quests do not collapse those sentences into each other.

Halloran's partner was killed on an Iron Rose hit. The fifteen-year file stays his secret. The daughter, the man she is seeing, and that man's father stay the faction tension and a fail condition, not a speech he gives.

The nephew's name is Marco, and Dom is reaching toward Halloran for a surveillance contract. The public tension says nephew and does not name him. The quest does not name him and does not send Dom to the walkup.
Bell saw a Thorpe shipment cross-loaded with Hub Bazaar goods. q_crime_bell_tip already owns one purchased tip. This slice does not buy it and does not ask about the Hub.
Maddox owes Iniko three favours. The wharf has no placed set. He is not given a stall.
Dahlia holds Silas's ledger for emergencies. crime_dahlia_02_steal already owns that door. The cup quest stays the volume row.
Ada's second log and the cross-world predation read stay crime_ada_anomaly_log and her secret. q_crime_morgue_cross stays the volume extension.
Pia's indictment file stays her secret. crime_thorpe_03_haldane stays the canon delivery. The courthouse has no district id, so she is not stood.
Old Lou's back room is neutral ground for the Thorpes and the precinct. S09 already left that secret unrendered. The Sunken Anchor has no coordinate. q_crime_collar_stays remains his only errand.
Pidgeon saw a shimmer at the wharf. A child is not placed on a floor, and the wharf set is still unplaced.
Mama's shotgun, The Rose, is on her appearance sheet. It is not spawned. No quest hands it over.
The generated row Iron Racket reuses cipher_marks and carries a generated motto. It is not an eighth polity. The generated coast names spawn nothing.
thorpe_family, crime_watch, city_judiciary, and wharf_workers have faction ids on people and no country row, so they have no CountryCenter and no hash pin.
Role faction string delgado_syndicate and volume strings ghost_contracts are not the canon ids. This slice writes no faction delta, so it does not open a third book.
boss_rule: enc_outstanding, enc_stair_switch, enc_hook_shift, enc_rotor_saddle, and raid_unpaid_shift stay S09. They are the coast's combat. A captain, a matriarch, an accountant, an agent, a detective, a block lead, and a corner sitter have no health table. Killing any of them fails the quest they give and does not drop a stamp, a slip, or a pin.

political_reading.reading: Budget 6 stays S09's, spent on the warehouse anchor first. The role tag says delgado_syndicate. The country file puts that anchor inside both circles. They are dock muscle. They are not Mama's three unnamed skimmers and not Dom's block.
Budget 3 stays on the unclaimed street. Hoods are not the North Market Gang, not the 14th, and not a Hexshore clerk.
Three solos on the warehouse, zero while the unpaid shift fields its own two. A collar is a working mark. Politics does not add a fourth dog at an office.
Night floor of the gap. Not a Hexshore ledger and not Ada's unexplained cause.
Cap stays zero until the wharf set is placed. q_crime_gull_drop is not rewritten. A gull is not moved inland to mark an office.
The bill, on the volume clock, on pilings that still have no coordinate. Precincts and syndicates do not get a second collector.
One rotor at dawn on the gap, inside enc_rotor_saddle only. It is not the Luminary strike and not a federal eye.

S09's mob floors used a fixed (+8, −6) step of 10 m. Those floors are cited and not moved. They are not the hash places, and this facet does not stand a unique on a fixed-step label.

geography.docks_versus_inland: The Rose estate sits 18.88 m from the warehouse anchor and inside the Ghost disk. Calling that inland would invent a city the coordinates do not have. The separated desks are Hexshore at 70.51 m, the federal floor outside the Ghost disk, and the south overlap where Dom, the precinct house, and the walkup sit within 17.04 m of one another, 78.59 m south of the warehouse. The 37.58 m gap is the street between those two lives. Bell sits on the gap. He does not sit on the hash dock.

cultures.who: Ghost Network and Iron Rose, on the same wet ground
cultures.law: The truce is seven minutes in a dockside back room with no witnesses, Year -1. Both walked out alive. The cease-fire dates from that night. What was said is not in the public sentence.
motto_pair: Seen once is once too many.

cultures.who: 14th Precinct, Halloran & Greer, North Market Gang
cultures.law: The precinct takes Iron Rose protection money quietly and covers the Ghost Network when it suits. The block takes no kids under 16, no work for the cops, and no work for Iron Rose. The walkup works for the client. Three claims cover Dom's morning pin.

cultures.who: Hexshore Holdings and the Federal Organized-Crime Task Force
cultures.law: RICO, as the federal goal writes it, runs across the 14th, the Iron Rose, and the Hexshore ring. It does not add the Ghost Network. The public tip is anonymous. The public ledger is someone else's. The desks are 93.22 m apart.

vendors.law_cited: Tips are quests, not stackable items. One purchase of a tip per slate.
vendors.backstory_public: Hooded, same corner, has informed for three precincts and two families, never a free tip and never a wrong one on the sheet. This facet does not name the precincts or the families.

vendors.why_no_stall: He is a fence on crime_wharf. The wharf named set has no coordinate. q_crime_maddox_mark and q_crime_folded_knife already use him. A second stall would invent stock.
vendors.backstory_public: On the wharf since he was fifteen. Friendly to cash. Knows what the dock is fencing. The three favours stay unrendered.

vendors.why_no_stall: The Sunken Anchor has no coordinate and no drink item in the vendor file. Inventing a glass would be a new id. q_crime_collar_stays is his errand. The memorial of eleven sailors and three pulled from the water is lore, and it belongs on the pier, which is the unplaced wharf, not on the warehouse anchor.
vendors.backstory_public: Owns the bar. Pretends to be deaf. Pulled three of the eleven out of the water when a docking line failed. The Watch has thrown a memorial every year since.

side_quests.title: Estate — Seven Minutes, No Transcript

objectives.text: At the estate pin, ask when the cease-fire started. She will say a seven-minute meeting, both walked out alive, and she will not add a sentence.
Walk to the warehouse anchor S09 already placed at (10.72, 32.9). It is 18.88 m from the estate and inside both circles. Do not move the labor or the hounds.
From that anchor, leave the Ghost capital and the Rose capital empty. Do not step onto (2.72, 38.9) or (−6.41, 40.5). There is no halal room to enter.
Bring back the public fact only: seven minutes, both alive, no transcript, no pin in your hand.

fail: Hand her q_crime_rose_errand's door as if it were this meeting

world_hooks.board_line: The estate board shows seven minutes and no added line.
world_hooks.gossip_on_complete: Mama confirmed the night and did not confirm the words.
world_hooks.prop_or_door: The estate pin. No new room. No shotgun.

side_quests.title: Estate — A Count of Three
side_quests.giver_spawn: presence_mama_estate. Same window. Turn this in before noon or she is gone.

objectives.text: Ask about the skim. She will say three lieutenants, and that she is letting it run. She will not say a name.
Write the count three. The pin holds Mama alone. Do not seat a lieutenant to make the number visible.
Walk the 12 m to the Rose capital at (−6.41, 40.5). The three are not standing there. Do not build them.
Return the count with empty hands. Do not collect the skim and do not bring Tomás out of his quarters.

world_hooks.gossip_on_complete: Mama kept the count and kept the names.
world_hooks.prop_or_door: No ledger prop. No coin stack.

objectives.text: At the house pin, ask which call the house answers. He will say the motto, and that protection money is taken quietly. He will not name a lieutenant.
Write that the cut is quiet. Do not open a drawer to prove it.
Walk toward the locker pin 16.70 m off. See that nobody from this facet staffs it. Do not open it.
Return with the motto and without a decision about the lieutenant or the agent.

world_hooks.board_line: The house answered. The locker stayed shut.
world_hooks.gossip_on_complete: Marquez kept the decision he has not made.

side_quests.title: Walkup — Not the Precinct Door
side_quests.giver_spawn: presence_halloran_office. Clock 8–12. He does not cross to Marquez.

objectives.text: At the office pin, ask which door is his. He will say this walkup, not the house 9.49 m away.
See both pins during 8–12 without either man leaving his own. The capitals 1.03 m apart are the overlap of the claims, not a shared desk.
Walk the 12.13 m to the residence pin. It is empty. Do not enter. Do not carry a story into it.
Return to the office with the two doors counted and nothing else.

fail: Name the man she is seeing
Path Halloran onto the precinct pin

world_hooks.board_line: Two doors, 9.49 m, neither one a residence.
world_hooks.gossip_on_complete: Halloran kept his office and kept his mouth.

side_quests.title: Secure Floor — Source Unknown

objectives.text: At the secure floor, ask about the tips. She will say they match the Hexshore ledger and that the source is unknown.
Write the word unknown. Do not improve it.
Step to the safe-house pin 2.73 m away. It is empty. It is not the source. Do not enter.
Return the word unknown. Do not set out for the Hexshore office to finish her sentence.

fail: Walk the 93.22 m as an accusation

side_quests.title: Hexshore — She Has Not Decided

objectives.text: At the office pin, ask about the private ledger. She will say an internal accountant keeps one, and that she has not decided whether to fire that person or partner them.
Leave the meeting without a decision. Do not offer one.
See both warren pins. Both are empty. Do not open either door.
Bring back the indecision and the two shut doors.

fail: Identify Iris as the tip source

world_hooks.gossip_on_complete: Iris left the ledger where it was.

side_quests.title: Block — The Pitch Already Failed

objectives.text: At the block pin, ask about the pitch. He will say a nephew turned it down, and that no one under 16 works this block. He will not say the nephew's name.
Write the rule. Do not call a child out to illustrate it. Pidgeon is not on this pin.
Walk to the alley-network pin. It is empty. The Iron Rose corner he watches is not staffed by this facet. Do not post a recruiter.
Return the refusal as a thing that already happened. Do not start the retaliation.

fail: Start a fight on the block

world_hooks.board_line: The pitch was refused. The alley is empty.
world_hooks.gossip_on_complete: Dom kept the morning and did not keep a war.

side_quests.title: Gap — Docks One Way, Block the Other
side_quests.giver_spawn: presence_bell_gap. Even day_index, 10–16. If he has no mesh, this quest cannot be turned in.

objectives.text: On an even day, at the gap midpoint, sit long enough for him to not sell you anything. He may say he has worked three precincts and two families. He will not name them, and he will not give a free tip.

Face the placed docks. The warehouse anchor is 35.55 m from his crate. That is the overlap, rain and sodium, not a pier. Do not hang a memorial here. The eleven and the three belong on the wharf, and the wharf set is unplaced.
Walk south to Dom's hash pin, 78.59 m from the warehouse and 44.45 m from the crate. That is the inland block. Do not recruit on the way.
Come back without a purchase. The slate stays at one. q_crime_bell_tip is the purchase, if it is taken at all.

fail: Move Bell onto the hash dockside or the subway pin
Hold the Anchor memorial on the warehouse

world_hooks.board_line: One slate. The gap still has no country on it.
world_hooks.gossip_on_complete: Bell sat. The docks stayed north. The block stayed south.
world_hooks.prop_or_door: prop_dock_crate on the midpoint. No new stock id.
